newsitem.title: USA: Global Casinos Inc sees higher Q1 97 loss.
newsitem.headline: Global Casinos Inc sees higher Q1 97 loss.

text.p: Global Casinos Inc said on Tuesday it expects a loss in the fiscal 1997 first quarter that is greater than normal for the seasonally slow quarter.
The company did not provide a specific figure and could not be immediately reached.
The company said in a release that the estimated loss would offset the one-time gain of $1 million it would get from debt restructure if the reorganization plan for Casinos USA is approved.
The company on Tuesday reported a $0.17 per share loss for fiscal 1996, compared to a $0.22 per share loss in 1995.
